tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Get the UpCloud account: username, remaining credits and the account resource limits

tools.name: list_servers
tools.description: List the cloud servers on the UpCloud account, optionally filtered by state or a free-text search

state.description: Optional server state to filter by

search.description: Optional pattern matched against name, title, uuid, zone, IP address, hostname, tag or template name

tools.name: list_storages
tools.description: List the storages accessible to the UpCloud account, with size, tier, state and zone

tools.name: list_zones
tools.description: List the UpCloud zones available to the account, including private cloud zones and their parents

needs_review: Tools written 2026-09-12 from the official API 1.3 documentation (sections 3-accounts, 5-zones, 8-servers, 9-storages): every path, query parameter, state enum and response key above is copied from the documented example responses. UpCloud nests its collections one level deep (servers.server[], storages.storage[], zones.zone[]), so the picks address them with dotted array keys.

Scaffolded auth (HTTP basic, username plus password) stands: the API 1.3 documentation authenticates every request with basic auth on the UpCloud username and password, and the live host answers a dummy pair with a structured AUTHENTICATION_FAILED 401.
No _probe hints are needed or supplied: all four reads are parameter-free account-level routes, so the blind harness reaches each documented path without substituting anything.

Only list_servers documents pagination (limit/offset) and filters, so only it carries a clamp. Storage listing narrows by PATH segment (/1.3/storage/private, /1.3/storage/template and so on) rather than by query, so this tool reads the unfiltered list; adding the type variants would mean four more tools rather than an input.
